user_saw: Nothing visible to users; startup performance collectors could stop at a green /readyz before the batched terminal timeline events were written, missing startup evidence.
summary: Gateway startup now calls flushDiagnosticsTimeline() before dispatch readiness and after the post-attach span, so batched timeline events are on disk before /readyz can turn green.
reasoning: The diagnostics timeline writer batches events and flushes on a later setImmediate turn, which is fine for its own contract; it only became wrong once benchmark/perf collectors (scripts/bench-*, scripts/perf/*) used /readyz as the end of their evidence window. The batching code is older than the history I could search (no in-repo commit found by path-limited search), the change is a forward-port from release/2026.10.10 whose own message names no cause, and the fix notes main's readiness ordering differs from the release branch, so I name no cause or trigger commit.
